lede: What Korean and global players run in PvP: regular Arena (아레나) and Rumble Arena (와글와글 아레나), taken from DCInside, the official Naver cafe, YouTube guides and crumb.gg. Every claim links to the post it came from.
caveat: Snapshot of 2026-09-27, four days into Rumble Arena and Princess Bari. Stars are rarely readable in screenshots, no site publishes win rates for either mode, and regular Arena has no ladder data at all.
footer: Built from the research record's evidence captures.
formation_slots: A deck cookie's slot reads row<R>-<C>. R is the row as displayed on the owner's formation screen (1 = top, 2 = bottom). C is the column counted left to right, 1–6. Column 1 is the back line and column 6 the front, inferred from attack ranges (Macaron range 7 and Oven Wanderer sit in column 1; Herb and Moon Rabbit, range 1–1.25, in column 6); neither the game nor crumb.gg labels it. crumb.gg's slot index i maps to row i%2+1, column ⌊i/2⌋+1. An opponent's defense card appears to show the grid mirrored, so decks known only from such a card carry no slots.

you.summary: With every cookie built, both modes come down to the Bari charge core at high stars. In regular Arena, defend with Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola at 8–10★ Bari and Oven and attack sub-8★ Bari decks with the Rye one-carry deck. In Rumble Arena, run the standard 12 with King Choco Drop, Holy Baby Drop and Hot Doggie.
changes: Captain Milk at merc squad Lv.4 with 방어구 수리 특약 + 열정페이, and check Milk is ATK #1 in battle, counting pet, perk and captain ATK%.
Build a separate arena gear preset: Skill Haste on all six right-side pieces, Skill AMP + crit rate on weapons, crit RES + DR on armour.
Push Bari past 5★ first (second soul target), then toward 8–10★ for regular Arena; Rumble tolerates lower stars while the Season 1 Charge buff lasts.
Put Rockstar with 3–4 Skill Haste lines in the Rye deck's flex slot.
Keep an attack preset with an accuracy line for evasion defenders.
Re-check the Rumble team when the Season 2 buff is announced: the Charge buff is what carries Oven and Cherry Cola.

arena.lede: Regular, per-server Arena. Two decks lead as of 2026-09-27: the Rye one-carry deck and Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola, with the matchup decided by Bari's and Oven's stars.
arena.caveat: No stats site covers regular Arena, so rankings rest on forum posts and screenshots. Many screenshots posted as Arena are Rumble (server tags, +125/+175 medals); those are counted under Rumble.

rules.title: Format
rules.body: Asynchronous auto-battle: your attack team fights another player's saved defense team. Attack and defense teams are set separately. No bans, picks or rounds. You pick the opponent from a list; refreshing it can cost crystals. Continuous challenge (auto-repeat) since 2026-09-10.

rules.title: Team size
rules.body: 12 cookies and 3 pets per side, plus a captain and mercenary perks.

rules.title: Battle length
rules.body: About 60 s (the client stage table sets a 60,000 ms limit, last wave annihilated). Near the end the game announces '종료 임박 피해량이 더 증가합니다!' and damage increases. Speeds x0.5–x2 and skip.

rules.title: Matchmaking and visibility
rules.body: Per server; rankings are per server. Opponents' names and power are visible before you attack, but their gear isn't.

rules.title: Seasons and tiers
rules.body: Seasons of about two weeks, closing at 12:00 KST; Season 5 is live on 2026-09-27. From Season 3 (patch 2026-08-27) ranks 1–3 get Champion 1/2/3, and Master 4 to Grand Master 1 promote by absolute rank; Champion 1 needs 3,200 points and overall 1st. Promotion examples: Elite Master 1 needs 3,000 trophies and top 30; Grand Master 2 needs 3,000 and top 5.

rules.title: Points
rules.body: A defense loss to a lower player costs up to −5; the attacker gains +15 to +25. Revenge attacks from the defense log recoup more than the loss. Guide 43444 puts a failed defense at 1–3 points.

rules.title: Rewards
rules.body: Wins only (not losses) give Fame points, which level Boss, Element and Crit DMG (+74–76% at Fame Lv.112), plus Victory Medals. First promotions pay diamonds: Elite Master 1 and Grand Master 3 4,000, Grand Master 2 6,000. Season-end rewards by rank: Season 3 2nd received 50,000 crystals and 5,000 medals.

rules.title: Stats that apply
rules.body: Level, stars, collection, gear, plate enhancement, sugar runes, pet ownership effects, captain and mercenary perks apply. Breakthrough, Stellar Link, Gnome Lab and Guild Lab don't, so displayed power overstates PvP strength. The PvE final-damage power bracket is fixed at 100% in PvP. Guide 43444 lists perks as not applying; player tests say they do.

rules.title: Season buffs
rules.body: Regular Arena has no season passive. In Season 1 the defense team's DMG reduction wasn't applied (fixed from Season 2).

rumble_arena.lede: Rumble Arena (와글와글 아레나, 와레나): the cross-server arena added on 2026-09-23. The top 100 run one 12-cookie team built on the Oven–Bari charge core, carried by the Season 1 Charge buff.
rumble_arena.caveat: Four days of data. The game hides some defenders, so crumb.gg's usage counts are lower bounds, and crumb.gg shows no levels, stars, runes or gear.

rules.title: Format
rules.body: The same auto-battle as Arena, alongside it rather than replacing it, but in one cross-server pool with no server-age brackets. Attack and defense teams are set separately, with 5 presets. No draft, bans or picks.

rules.title: Team size
rules.body: Up to 12 cookies (two rows of 6) and 3 pets. Empty slots are allowed; some players leave a 1-cookie defense to drop points on purpose.

rules.title: Battle length
rules.body: About 60 s with a visible countdown; speeds x0.5–x2, auto-repeat and skip.

rules.title: Seasons
rules.body: Irregular seasons, each with its own Rumble-only passive. Season 1 runs 2026-09-23 03:00 UTC to 2026-10-08 (battles close 03:00 UTC, 12:00 KST); the end date comes from the in-game timer and crumb.gg, not from official text.

rules.title: Season buffs
rules.body: Season 1: Charge (돌격형) cookies get +30% max HP, and all cookies and summons get +30% DMG reduction. Shown in the official announcement GIF, the in-game 와글와글 버프 panel and the EN client ('Rumble Buff').

rules.title: Tickets
rules.body: Its own ticket. The free cap is 5, refilled daily, and unused refills don't bank; the UI showed 8 at launch (an acknowledged display bug). Extra tickets cost 1,000 mileage each with no limit.

rules.title: Points and hiding
rules.body: The win value shows before the fight (+6, +10 and +19 seen); a loss at the top cost −5. A successful defense gives +1 or +2 points and 125 Rumble medals; a failed one costs −1 to −4. At 2,000+ points the opponent's name, power and levels show as ??? (익명의 도전자) while lineup and pets stay visible. Revenge attacks are available from the defense log.

rules.title: Leagues
rules.body: Platinum, Diamond, Master 5 to Master 1, then Champion 1 (the top grade). Promotion needs points and a percentile: Master 5 needs 2,000 points and top 80% and pays 1,500 gems. The EN client shows 'Crystal' tier names.

rules.title: Rewards
rules.body: Season ranking (gems + Rumble medals): 1st 60,000 + 25,000, 2nd 50,000, 3rd 45,000 (3,200 points for the top 3); top 10 40,000, top 30 35,000, top 100 30,000 (3,000 points); Master top 5/10/20/30% 25,000/24,000/23,000/22,000 gems with 20,000 or 15,000 medals (2,000 points). Daily ranking mails 2,500 medals to the top 100 and 2,000 to Master top 5–30%. Medals buy daily-dungeon keys, chocolate bars, syrup, Stella rune rewards and a random box in the Rumble shop.

rules.title: Stats that apply
rules.body: Per players, cookie stars and gear count, while breakthrough, research lab and Stella don't, and there are no guild effects. No official statement was found; perks likely apply as in Arena.
